snippet.title: Ranma 1/2: Battle Renaissance: Ranma Saotome "Story Mode" Playthrough (PS1)
snippet.description: Ranma 1/2:Battle Renaissance full playthrough. Released in 1996 in Japan only for the Sony Playstation, this was a mediocre attempt at creating a 3D fighting game for Ranma 1/2. I thought it was the coolest thing ever at the time. Played through this game with Ranma because I thought his ending was the best. #ranma½ #ps1 #ranmasaotome #rumikotakahashi
